purpose: Controlled search recovery: first conservative batch only. Preserve technical assets while reducing low-signal/high-similarity carrier pages on index surfaces.

batch1.selection: Phase127-restored carrier pages with 0 clicks, <=2 impressions, nearest-neighbor similarity >=0.80, and 2024-or-earlier/known-legacy device scope.

observation.expand_only_if: whole-site impressions/query breadth and retained-page rankings are stable or improving

seo_rule: Final indexable page count is an outcome, not a KPI.
gsc_note: Latest URL-level GSC CSV was not available in this workspace. Batch 1 intentionally uses a narrow historical-signal + duplication gate. Re-score with current GSC before batch 2.
